StoreVouchers.View.description: View store voucher usage and linked orders in the app.

System.ManageAppDownloads.name: Manage app releases
System.ManageAppDownloads.description: Register OTA updates and generate rollback commands.

System.ManagePerformanceBaseline.name: Manage performance and quality baseline
System.ManagePerformanceBaseline.description: Freeze performance and quality baselines that meet the observation and coverage requirements.

System.ManageScheduledTasks.name: Manage scheduled tasks
System.ManageScheduledTasks.description: Switch the instance that runs scheduled tasks and turn tasks on or off, on the web admin.

System.ManageSettings.name: Manage system settings
System.ManageSettings.description: Manage invoice email, payment terminal and emergency login key settings on the web admin.

System.ViewMobileAppInstallLinks.name: View app install QR codes (mobile)
System.ViewMobileAppInstallLinks.description: View the latest iOS and Android releases and their install QR codes in the app.

System.ViewAppDownloads.name: View app releases
System.ViewAppDownloads.description: View app downloads and WPF versions on the web admin. The matching pages in the app also need the Admin role.

System.ViewLogs.name: View system logs
System.ViewLogs.description: View the system centre logs on the web admin.

Users.ManagePosTerminalPermissions.name: Manage store POS access
Users.ManagePosTerminalPermissions.description: Set cashiers' POS permissions for each store on the web admin.

Users.ManageRoles.name: Manage user roles
Users.ManageRoles.description: Assign or remove roles from users.

Users.CreateStoreStaff.name: Create store staff
Users.CreateStoreStaff.description: In the app's staff list, create staff accounts for your primary store (not web user management).

Users.EditStoreStaff.name: Edit store staff
Users.EditStoreStaff.description: In the app's staff list, edit or disable staff at your primary store and manage their personal codes (not web user management).

Users.ResetStoreStaffPassword.name: Reset store staff passwords
Users.ResetStoreStaffPassword.description: In the app's staff list, reset passwords for staff at your primary store and make them change it at their next login (not web user management).

Users.View.name: View users
Users.View.description: View user lists and details in the app's Staff and User management pages.

Users.ViewStoreStaff.name: View store staff
Users.ViewStoreStaff.description: In the app's Staff management, view the store staff list and details (not web user management).

Users.ViewWebConsole.name: View web user management
Users.ViewWebConsole.description: Show and open the user management page on the web admin.

Warehouse.Manage.name: Manage warehouse
Warehouse.Manage.description: Legacy all-in-one warehouse permission: the same as having Manage warehouse products, orders, categories and locations, and also allows pre-orders, retail price changes and product record APIs.

Warehouse.ManageCategories.name: Manage warehouse categories
Warehouse.ManageCategories.description: Manage warehouse categories on the web admin.

Warehouse.ManageLocations.name: Manage warehouse locations
Warehouse.ManageLocations.description: Manage warehouse locations on the web admin.

Warehouse.ManageOrders.name: Manage warehouse orders
Warehouse.ManageOrders.description: Manage store orders, pre-orders, picking sheets and invoices on the web admin and in the app.

Warehouse.Picking.name: Pick store orders
Warehouse.Picking.description: In the app (Order picking), scan to pick, fill in missing inner qty and submit picked quantities. Included with Manage warehouse or Manage warehouse orders.

Warehouse.StartPicking.name: Start picking on print
Warehouse.StartPicking.description: Web page /warehouse/store-order/picking/:id - printing or downloading the picking sheet moves the order from Submitted to Picking. Granted separately from order editing; not included with Manage warehouse.

Warehouse.StoreOrderReturn.name: Store order returns
Warehouse.StoreOrderReturn.description: Web page /warehouse/store-orders order detail - record returned goods as a negative ship quantity (returns reduce the amount; a negative net total becomes a credit note). Nobody has it by default; granted manually and not included with Manage warehouse.

Warehouse.ManageProducts.name: Manage warehouse products
Warehouse.ManageProducts.description: Manage warehouse products, retail price changes and product grades on the web admin and in the app.

Warehouse.CancelPriceUpdateTasks.name: Cancel price update tasks
Warehouse.CancelPriceUpdateTasks.description: Web page /warehouse/products/price-update-tasks and the app's Prices & labels page - cancel pending store price update tasks (per product, across all stores; only removes the reminder, never changes any price, cannot be undone). Accounts with Manage warehouse products have it automatically.

SupplierPreorder.Manage.name: Manage supplier seasonal preorders
SupplierPreorder.Manage.description: Web pages /supplier-preorders and /supplier-preorders/orderers - import KFC, Dats, Brazco and other seasonal order forms, choose participating stores, manage who may order for which store, lock at the deadline and export the summary (can still edit after the deadline). Nobody has it by default; granted manually.

SupplierPreorder.Order.name: Order on supplier seasonal preorders
SupplierPreorder.Order.description: Web page /supplier-preorder-ordering - entry to seasonal preorder ordering. Which stores a person may order for is set only on the Orderer authorization page, not by managed stores or store manager role. Nobody has it by default; granted manually.
